input.free_text_description: The system operates in the e-commerce, authentication domain. It serves API Consumer, Customer as its primary actors. The main business capabilities include inventory, order, product. Core business data revolves around InventoryItem, Order, OrderItem, Product. The system enforces access control and identity verification for protected operations.

user_stories.story: As a Customer, I want to place and track orders, so that I can purchase items and monitor their delivery status.
As a Customer, I want to browse and manage products, so that I can find and interact with the product catalog.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage inventory operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
As a API Consumer, I want to interact with context copy hystrix concurrency strategy functionality, so that the system fulfills my needs.
As a API Consumer, I want to interact with inventory item repository functionality, so that the system fulfills my needs.
